metadata.description: Marketplace pessoal: 19 plugins (skills, hooks e automações) para Claude Code.

plugins.name: archify
plugins.description: Create professional architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML files with SVG graphics, dark/light themes, and export to PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM. Accepts plain-language descriptions or pasted Mermaid code.

plugins.name: bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstraps a new machine to this versioned Claude Code setup. Two layers: (1) auto-syncs third-party marketplaces & plugins via hooks (manifest-driven convergence), and (2) applies the versioned global config — env vars, permissions, behavior flags, the global CLAUDE.md, and a machine-resolved statusLine. Replaces bootstrap-third-party. Run /bootstrap:setup once per new machine. Ships the 'Clean Style' output style (single prose ceiling, pasted evidence exempt) and a report-only conformance checker that diffs the live machine against the versioned contract.

plugins.name: branches
plugins.description: Diz quais branches dá pra apagar e quais NÃO dá. O `git branch --merged` mente por omissão: squash-merge e rebase produzem sha novo, então a branch aparece como não-mergeada mesmo com o conteúdo inteiro no tronco — e é por isso que a pilha cresce até o deploy reclamar de 15 branches abertas. Classifica por CONTEÚDO (patch-id), mostra o que só existe em cada branch antes de você decidir, e apaga só o que você marcar — sempre com tag de resgate. Mais dois avisos: no push de branch que ainda não entrou no tronco, e no começo da sessão quando há branch parada há mais de um mês.

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Dispara o handoff quando o contexto DESTA sessão passa do threshold (default 80%). Estado por-sessão (v1.2.0) — uma sessão cheia não bloqueia as concorrentes. v1.3.0: não interrompe se já estiver no meio de um handoff, e faz o Claude EXECUTAR o /handoff (decision:block) em vez de só parar. Kill-switch: ~/.claude/context-guard/mode=off.

plugins.name: fallow
plugins.description: Runs Fallow (static JS/TS analyzer — dead code, duplication, complexity), classifies findings by type and confidence, and delivers an interactive report where you pick what to clean. Audits the Fallow report (convergence goal + liveness propagation) to catch false-positives the static analysis misses — cron/systemd, HTTP routes, dynamic imports — framed as tool limitations, not code bugs. Cleanup with a safety net (preview + build/test).

plugins.name: graphify-guard
plugins.description: Ensures graphify knowledge graphs get consulted when relevant. SessionStart heads-up when a project has a graph; PreToolUse net redirects blind grep/glob/find to `graphify query` once per session. Detects stale graphs and offers `graphify --update`. Defense in depth, fail-open, monorepo-aware.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Relentless design review that works the decision tree in rounds — it asks the whole frontier at once and finds facts itself instead of spending the owner's turn on them. Two question channels, the owner picks: a multiple-choice page with a free-text field (default), or one question at a time in the CLI. Also how each /start-doc stage of agreement is closed — as the path to the agreement, never its judge: the grilling never approves, the owner does, in the document's own frontmatter.

plugins.name: grill-with-docs
plugins.description: Relentless design review that challenges plans against the project's domain model, sharpens terminology, and updates CONTEXT.md and ADRs inline as decisions crystallise. Also how a /start-doc stage of agreement is closed when there is already a CONTEXT.md or an ADR to confront — as the path to the agreement, never its judge: the grilling never approves, the owner does, in the document's own frontmatter.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Global editing guardrails as hooks: post-edit lint & type-check (JS/TS/Python), an LLM scope-cop that blocks UI edits drifting from the approved plan, and an Agent Teams misuse guard. Portable across machines — replaces hand-rolled hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json. Run /guardrails:setup once per machine to set the env var and clear the old hooks.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Session continuity in a single command — /handoff detects the session state and routes: full context → saves a complete knowledge-transfer document; freshly cleared session → resumes from it. Workspace-aware: the handoff belongs to the project the session touched (resolves the .git boundary of the edited files), so it works for a standalone project, a monorepo (one HANDOFF-<module>.md per module), or an umbrella folder with nested projects — no more clobbering between parallel sessions on the same root. Optional [salvar|retomar] argument forces the mode.

plugins.name: improve
plugins.description: Generic self-improvement implementer using the autoresearch ML methodology. Reads the app's IMPROVEMENT_PROGRAM.md, fetches proposals from GitHub Issues (label 'autoresearch'), implements changes.

plugins.name: intent-guard
plugins.description: EXPERIMENTAL — Guarda de intenção: caderno append-only dos pedidos verbatim do usuário + gates de plano, checkpoint e ENTREGA (auditoria independente por subagente de contexto virgem, prompt canônico, veredito CONFIRMADO/INFERIDO com evidência). v0.4.0: auditoria dispara no COMMIT (não a cada turno) e ganha escada de custo — pedido com receita mecânica (ex.: 'commit push' → compara hashes) é resolvido por CÓDIGO, sem agente; numa sessão real 4 de 7 pedidos eram isso, ~50k tokens cada. O juiz só ESCOLHE de um catálogo fechado, nunca escreve comando. v0.3.0: pedidos escopados por sessão (sessões paralelas dividiam a lista de vivos). v0.2.0: tree-hash ignora artefato de execução; juízes internos não poluem o caderno. Baixa automática é experimental. Kill-switch: ~/.claude/intent-guard/mode=off.

plugins.name: lixeiro
plugins.description: Encerra os processos que a sessão abriu e esqueceu — servidor de desenvolvimento, suíte pendurada, compilação em modo observador. O critério é procedência, nunca nome de programa: um hook anota na origem o que abriu processo, e só o que foi anotado pode ser encerrado. Ao fim de cada turno morre a suíte que ficou pendurada e o servidor cuja CPU não subiu desde o turno anterior — o que está em uso sobrevive. Ao fim da sessão morre tudo que ela abriu, e na abertura seguinte o que sessões mortas deixaram de pé. Máquina virtual, serviço de contêiner e os serviços do próprio programa nunca recebem sinal, só aparecem no relatório. Traz também /faxina, o irmão manual, que mostra tudo que está de pé e encerra só o que você marcar.

plugins.name: principles
plugins.description: Contextual system design principles for planning and review. Reads PRINCIPIOS-SISTEMAS.md, maps relevant categories to the current context, generates a practical guide with WHY + HOW.

plugins.name: project-doc
plugins.description: Generate a modular documentation system from ALL project evidence — the invocation discourse, files, handoffs, memory, graph, git log, and session transcripts — kept in a versioned append-only journal, projected into a lightweight CLAUDE.md routing table + .claude/docs/*.md per concern + thin pointers (AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules). FOUR skills: /project-doc (mines everything), /doc-touch (incremental), /start-doc (interviews the human for the authorial docs no mining can produce — and never invents them), and /design-md (absorbed from the standalone design-md plugin: writes/validates/exports Google's DESIGN.md format via the official CLI). v3.30.0: the plan gate now charges the FIFTH stage of the agreement — funcionalidades (.claude/docs/features.md), the feature list the interview proposes and the owner curates; derived from the four earlier stages, it is charged last, under the same divergence-by-mark rule, and an open (or missing) features.md REFUSES the plan naming the stage. v3.29.0: the plan gate now charges the project's LAW — a .claude/docs/constituicao.md that exists but is still a draft (or whose body changed after the agreement) REFUSES the plan naming the file, because the document reviewers measure against cannot itself be unsigned; absence is not charged (no skill generates a constitution, so demanding one would be a dead-end refusal). v3.27.0: /start-doc's opening now READS the inherited decisions instead of asking them again — step 1 runs lib/organism.py inherited <root> --apresentar, whose render_inherited writes ONE LINE PER inherited item (golden rule + authorial items of the parent organism, each with its arquivo:linha source) from the real organism.yaml, and the skill walks the owner item by item (applies / applies with a caveat / does not apply); test_organism.py proves the item-by-item rendering against a real fixture — a new item in the parent doc becomes a new line — not the mention in the skill. v3.26.0: the stage agreement is now collected ON THE PAGE, with the whole document in sight — /start-doc's step 5 stopped presenting the text in the chat and now builds a /visual page with an aprovacao block (etapa + doc_integral verbatim + anchored index cards), which the program REFUSES to write without the integral text, and reads the verdict back from disk (~/.claude/visual-state/latest.json, state.feedback: val in keep|change|remove plus the note); test_start_doc_skill.py proves the assembly and the parse of the return by behavior, not by the presence of a sentence. v3.25.0: the agreement now records WHICH TEXT was approved — /start-doc's step 5 stopped being three hand-typed frontmatter lines and became a command (hooks/doc-aprovar.sh) that computes the mark of the document's BODY (doc_marca, lib-doc-mark.sh) and writes approved-sig: alongside status: approved and approved:, which is exactly what the plan gate recalculates to reopen a stage whose body was edited after the fact; the authorial contract lists the field, and test_doc_mark.sh proves by behavior that the mark moves with the body and not with the frontmatter. v3.23.0: the skill that writes documentation now carries the decoupling rule itself — a canonical section orders two concrete swaps in every doc it projects (a hard-coded count goes out and the COMMAND that produces it comes in; a prose list of plugin names goes out and the INDEX that enumerates them comes in), naming the enforcer (python3 scripts/desacoplamento_check.py) and the acopla-ok exemption; /doc-touch points at that section instead of keeping a copy that would drift. v3.19.0: /start-doc becomes a concepção in FOUR stages of agreement, in order — authorial (quality goals, constraints, context, strategy, glossary), architecture (architecture-intent.md), interface (design.md, only where a UI is detected) and journeys (journeys.md). Each stage has its own document and its own approval: it is presented in full, grilled with /grill-me or /grill-with-docs, corrected and RE-PRESENTED until the owner is satisfied, and only closes once his approval is written into the document's own frontmatter (status: approved + approved:). The grilling is the path to the agreement, never its judge — it neither approves nor rejects. And the plan gate stopped settling for 'has docs' — a documented project whose own quality-goals.md is missing or still open is now REFUSED (no cap, it used to stay silent), and any open stage refuses the plan — architecture (architecture-intent.md), interface or journeys — including in a brand-new project that never opened one, which is exactly the case that used to slip through. v3.21.0: the gate and the authorial contract stopped disagreeing — the mark it demands is the contract's own status: approved ('ready' is 'written', 'approved' is 'the owner agreed'), the architecture stage is architecture-intent.md (not solution-strategy.md, which belongs to stage 1), and both refusal messages are written under the repo's hook style profile: emoji header, one-sentence bullets, no markdown in a channel that renders none. v3.17.0: the doc-touch stamp is now a verb (--restamp) that writes generated, generated-commit and doc-sig in one go, preserving the DOC-SET gen instead of the code's — a doc cannot cite the commit that contains it, so the ritual is two commits and the tool now owns it. v3.16.0: the staleness measure the HOOKS consume (project_staleness) now honors generated-commit instead of a day-granularity date window, and matches scope entries with _scope_match instead of raw string intersection — a /doc-touch followed by a same-day commit no longer reports freshly generated docs as stale, and a doc scoped by directory can finally go stale. v3.15.0: design.md becomes the 6th authorial doc, gated to projects with a detected frontend (lib-has-frontend.sh); sessionstart-doc.sh now also nudges when a mined project has zero authorial docs (not just when there's no doc at all). Gen 3.8 adds the data-asset axis (data-stores.md + durability.md: every store enumerated, every store's backup declared or explicitly justified), runtime.md end-to-end scenarios, verified-by provenance in frontmatter, and a project-root ADR log. A plan gate hook blocks planning in an undocumented project until /start-doc runs, with a verbal escape. Scrubber moves secrets to a vault, never to git. Supports delta/--deep/--rebuild, monorepo layouts, artifact cleanup, and ORGANISM support (de-silo) with an inverted blast-radius gate.

plugins.name: qa-loop
plugins.description: Review→fix loop that stops at diminishing returns, not at zero. Runs as a deterministic Workflow (Opus reviews → Opus plans/adjudicates → fixes; gate, churn and stop condition live in code). Anchored to the plan in 3 buckets — implementation / plan-drift / broken-plan — and to the project's own quality goals, read from .claude/docs/quality-goals.md at review time rather than copied into the skill. Regression gate per fix, accepted-limits, a human HTML report plus an agent-facing journal. Replaces qa, rev6 and iterate.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Production deploy flow: lint, type-check, commit, push, deploy in one disciplined sequence. Triggers on 'ship', 'manda', 'deploya tudo'.

plugins.name: slides
plugins.description: Markdown → keynote-grade single-file HTML deck. Two modes: (A) transcription — renders a ready .md faithfully, never invents text; (B) explainer — drives the didactics (narrative structure, audience level, granular vs summary, infographics) to teach a concept, grounded (factual + current). Theme system (VIU default), no-JS adaptive (WhatsApp thumbnail).

plugins.name: sovai
plugins.description: Autonomous run mode — executes a plan end to end with no pauses, checkpoints or confirmations. Skips blockers without silent workarounds, records every decision, runs a headless qa-loop pass and delivers a structured report. The engine is a deterministic Workflow (decompose → execute → review) and a PreToolUse hook enforces it: while the mission is armed every sub-agent spawn is denied. The reviewer judges the work against the SPEC, not against the orchestrator's own decomposition — reviewing against your own breakdown is a closed circuit where a wrong breakdown gets approved. Five axes: spec · the project's own quality goals · traceability (every task carries its requirement and its definition of done) · completeness · cohesion. A dead agent degrades the mission instead of killing the engine.

plugins.name: vision
plugins.description: Dá olhos ao Claude delegando a um servidor de visão (Qwen3.6 35B A3B VL, API OpenAI-compatible). Expõe a tool see_image para descrever imagens quando o modelo do Claude não as lê.

plugins.name: visual
plugins.description: CLI walls-of-text → interactive HTML dark-theme views. The page carries the EVIDENCE, not the account of it: real artifact embedded, raw output verbatim, provenance for every number — enforced by a pre-ExitPlanMode gate. Prose is REFUSED by the builder: every text field is checked (≤140 chars per bullet, one sentence each, no continuation connective, max 6 per block) and a violation aborts without writing the page. Each problem's body is born folded — the title stays visible, consequence and proposal open on click under a label derived from the content itself. Plans, diagnostics and decisions in the browser with live sync back to Claude. Regravar um plano nunca apaga em silêncio o que não veio no pacote: o init parcial FUNDE o bloco de requisitos por id — o requisito que só existe no arquivo fica, e o executor recebe a nota do que foi mantido.
